IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Ericksen, Roach, Bailey, and Rolfes

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing funding for passenger-only ferry construction.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing funding for passenger-only ferryconstruction; adding a new section to chapter 47.60 RCW, creating a newsection; and making an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department may purchase five passenger-only ferries using thedesign-build procurement process under this chapter. The design-buildprocurement process must be consistent with procedures used by thedepartment for highway construction contracts, ensuring that bestpractices are employed to speed vessel delivery and contain costs. Inorder to prequalify for this bid, the bidder must be able to designferries that produce a sufficiently low wake and provide high-speedtransit through Rich Passage in the Puget Sound and can be deliveredwithin two years of a notice to proceed.

During the 2009-2011 fiscal biennium andbefore the expenditure of funds for the purposes described in RCW47.66.070, twenty-five million dollars deposited into the multimodal p. 1 HB 1209transportation account must be transferred to the passenger ferryaccount created under RCW 47.60.645 for the purposes described insection 1 of this act.

The sum of twenty-five million dollars, oras much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the bienniumending June 30, 2011, from the passenger ferry account to thedepartment of transportation for the purposes described in section 1 ofthis act.
